verdict.rationale: Orrick's own Patents page describes patent litigation at volume: more than 60 patent trials and more than 155 inter partes review proceedings, which implies the PTAB as a venue. Its Trademark, Copyright & Media page says the firm led three of IPLaw360's top-10 copyright cases of the decade. However, no specific courts, named venues, or case outcomes are described, and nothing documents trademark or trade-secret litigation. missing for 10: named courts/venues (e.g., district courts, ITC), specific case outcomes or wins, trademark and trade-secret litigation evidence, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm litigates IP disputes — patent, trademark, or trade-secret — with courts, venues, or outcomes described on its own pages

citations.quote: In the last five years, we've handled more than 60 patent trials
more than 155 inter partes review proceedings
our team led the charge for our clients in three of those cases—more than any other firm
